description:
**Job Description:**


**About Us**


At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
  

We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  

Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!


**Global Business Services**


Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations. Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation. In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.


**Process Overview**


The Global Information Security (GIS) is responsible for protecting Bank information systems, confidential and proprietary data, and customer information. The team develops the Bank’s Information Security strategy and policy, manages the Information Security program and identifies and addresses vulnerabilities, Develops, deploys and manages a risk\-based controls portfolio, Manages and operates a global security operations center that monitors, detects and responds to cybersecurity incidents.


**Job Description**


The individual will be part of The Cyber Security Technology, Identity authentication, access technology teams that are responsible for the ongoing development of applications used Enterprise\-wide covering authentication authorization. In this role, you will be using the experience you have gained throughout your career to work with a team of developers in the design, development, and implementation of complex, globally distributed, applications. We expect tech lead to be comfortable contributing throughout the application stack and we believe it is critical that you follow Agile best practices including common design patterns, proper source code control practices, delivery of unit test cases and CI/CD. Whether your teams are building applications from scratch, de\-bugging existing code, your skills will be tested and your knowledge\-base will grow as you rise to meet the challenges. You will use your communication skills to collaborate with global teams across the firm and you leadership skills to develop and coach your team.


**Responsibilities**


* Leverage deep technical knowledge to create technology solutions that address complex technical, architectural and organizational challenges.
* Partner with the Product Owners, Business Analysts, Testers, Site Reliability Engineers and Dev Ops to comprehensively deliver quality releases and ensure stability of the platforms.
* Own the quality of software delivered by the team you lead.
* Interact with client stakeholders, at a senior technical level, including collaborating to reach agreement on solution architecture, design and technical approach, while creating an optimal working environment for the development team.
* Coach and mentor intermediate developers to grow skills and drive effective delivery.
* Ensure strict adherence to delivery schedule and promote use of AI dev tooling available in enterprise

**Education :** B.E. / B. Tech/M.E. /M. Tech/B.Sc./M.Sc./BCA/MCA (prefer IT/CS specialization)


**Certifications If Any** : NA


**Experience Range :** 7\+ years


**Foundational skills**


* Previous Application Programming/Development Lead experience in designing, developing and deploying high\-volume, multi\-tiered, distributed transactional applications.
* Experience working in Agile SCRUM development process and a comprehensive understanding of various phases of Software Development Lifecycle.
* A disciplined thinker and capable of working across organizational boundaries in a very demanding, high\-output environment.
* Ability to communicate, written and verbal, with technical and non\-technical cross\-functional teams.
* Strong skills in design and developing robust Java, RESTAPI, and Micro Services. Proficiency in Spring / SpringBoot.
* Experience in UI development with React
* Hands\-on experience in Identity \& Authentication technologies including OAuth2/OIDC, SAML, FIDO/WebAuthn, PKI, and LDAP.
* Experience in Oracle database with SQL and PL/SQL queries
* Skilled in using CI/CD tool set (JIRA/Bitbucket/Jenkins/Artifactory/Ansible)
* Proficiency in development in Unix/Linux environment
* Experience in Web servers, Application servers

* Advanced Communication skills

description:

The Body Construction Engineering Manager – Process Simulation \& Virtual Commissioning is responsible for leading and developing a high\-performing engineering team supporting Body\-in\-White (BIW) manufacturing operations through advanced digital manufacturing technologies.


This role provides both technical and people leadership across process simulation, robotics validation, virtual commissioning, automation, and digital transformation initiatives. The position works closely with Manufacturing Engineering, Controls Engineering, Product Development, Manufacturing IT, suppliers, and plant operations teams to identify manufacturing risks early, optimize manufacturing processes, and improve production readiness prior to equipment installation and production launch.


The successful candidate will play a key role in advancing digital manufacturing capabilities, improving engineering efficiency, and establishing simulation and virtual commissioning standards across multiple automotive manufacturing programs and facilities.

**Team Leadership \& Capability Development**

* Build, lead, and develop a Body Process Simulation team supporting BIW manufacturing engineering activities.
* Define team structure, technical responsibilities, engineering standards, work processes, deliverables, and performance expectations.
* Lead, mentor, and coordinate a multidisciplinary team of engineers, simulation specialists, controls engineers, contractors, and supplier resources.
* Recruit, develop, and retain technical talent in process simulation, robotics, offline programming, virtual commissioning, automation, and digital manufacturing technologies.
* Establish competency frameworks, mentoring programs, training plans, and career development pathways.
* Manage resource planning, project workloads, budgets, supplier support, and delivery performance across multiple manufacturing programs and locations.
* Foster a culture focused on safety, collaboration, innovation, quality, continuous improvement, and standardization.

**Process Simulation \& Digital Manufacturing**

* Lead the application of Siemens Process Simulate, Tecnomatix, or similar digital manufacturing tools to validate body shop manufacturing processes prior to equipment installation.
* Establish standard methodologies for:
* Robot reach and accessibility studies
* Collision detection and avoidance
* Cycle time validation
* Tooling and weld gun accessibility validation
* Ergonomic assessments
* Robot path optimization
* Station layout verification
* Ensure simulation activities support manufacturing feasibility reviews, equipment design validation, tooling development, and process planning.
* Develop and maintain simulation models, robot libraries, tooling standards, process libraries, work instructions, and best practices.
* Improve simulation quality, model accuracy, data management practices, and process validation efficiency.
* Identify and communicate manufacturing risks, design concerns, capacity constraints, automation challenges, and process issues early during program development.

**Virtual Commissioning**

* Develop organizational capability in virtual commissioning technologies and methodologies.
* Lead validation of robot sequences, programmable logic controller (PLC) logic, safety interlocks, equipment interfaces, and automated manufacturing processes in a virtual environment.
* Define virtual commissioning standards, test procedures, acceptance criteria, and deployment methodologies.
* Collaborate with Controls Engineering, equipment suppliers, and plant teams to ensure an effective transition from virtual to physical commissioning.
* Support issue resolution related to robotics, controls, automation systems, simulation models, commissioning activities, and production support.

**Automation \& Digital Transformation**

* Drive automation and digital manufacturing initiatives to improve simulation efficiency, engineering productivity, and manufacturing validation processes.
* Identify opportunities to automate model creation, reporting, data validation, engineering analysis, and repetitive simulation activities.
* Support the adoption of advanced digital tools, data analytics, digital twins, and AI\-enabled engineering solutions to improve:
* Engineering productivity
* Manufacturing risk identification
* Root\-cause analysis
* Knowledge management
* Decision support
* Partner with Manufacturing IT, Controls Engineering, Product Development, and Data \& Analytics teams to evaluate and implement scalable digital manufacturing solutions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum 7\+ years of experience in automotive Body\-in\-White manufacturing, process engineering, manufacturing launches, equipment installation, commissioning, production trials, and ramp\-up activities.
* Minimum 3\+ years of experience in digital manufacturing, process simulation, robotics validation.
* Minimum 3\+ years of experience in Virtual commissioning.
* Proven experience leading and developing engineering teams and coordinating supplier and contractor resources.
* Hands\-on experience with Siemens Process Simulate, Tecnomatix, or equivalent manufacturing simulation platforms.
* Strong knowledge of body shop robotics, tooling, fixtures, automated manufacturing cells, and material handling systems.
* Working knowledge of industrial controls, PLC architecture, automation sequencing, robot\-controls integration, and virtual commissioning principles.
* Knowledge of BIW joining technologies, including resistance spot welding, arc welding, laser welding, adhesive bonding, riveting, clinching, or related manufacturing processes.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting multiple automotive OEM manufacturing environments.
* Advanced experience in offline robot programming and virtual commissioning.
* Exposure to AI\-enabled engineering tools, digital twin technologies, or manufacturing analytics solutions.
* Knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD\&T), Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), Production Part Approval Process (PPAP), Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA), Control Plans, and structured problem\-solving methodologies.
* Experience leading large, cross\-functional engineering teams across multiple manufacturing locations.

**Recruitment fraud is a scheme in which fictitious job opportunities are offered to job seekers typically through online services, such as false websites, or through unsolicited emails claiming to be from the company. ### **Location: Coimbatore**

  

  

**Summary:**

  

  

We're building AI\-powered intelligence workflows that connect multiple enterprise systems and surface real\-time insights where teams need them. We're looking for an engineer with solid hands\-on experience who can independently design, build, and ship production\-grade GenAI solutions \- from agentic workflows to end\-to\-end API integrations \- working directly alongside a senior AI architect.

  

  

You'll own workstreams, make technical decisions on architecture and integration patterns, and bring full\-stack engineering experience that shapes how we build \- not just execute tasks handed to you.

  

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**:

  

  

* Design, build, and deploy intelligent single and multi\-agentic applications using LLMs \- task decomposition, planning, and autonomous execution
* Build full\-stack AI\-powered applications \- backend APIs, frontend interfaces, and the integration layer connecting them to enterprise data systems
* Develop and own end\-to\-end AI\-powered workflows integrated with backend systems, APIs, and data pipelines across cloud platforms
* Build and iterate on RAG pipelines \- embeddings, vector databases, retrieval logic, and prompt design
* Prototype and ship PoCs using AI agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent)
* Integrate AI solutions across multiple enterprise platforms and APIs using REST, JSON, and cloud services
* Write clean, production\-ready code with documentation, error handling, and maintainability standards
* Translate business requirements into working GenAI solutions independently with minimal hand\-holding
* Bring in best practices \- CI/CD, testing, observability \- and help raise the bar for the team

* 3–5 years of software engineering or AI engineering experience

* End\-to\-end API integration experience across multiple systems
* Cloud platform experience \- AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Experience with AI agent frameworks \- LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving mindset \- owns failures end\-to\-end

**Good to have Skills:**

  

  

* Data engineering experience \- ETL pipelines, data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift), or similar

* MCP (Model Context Protocol) or agentic tool\-use patterns
* Experience in a fast\-moving startup or consulting environment

title: Agentic AI and Tableau Applications Lead - Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


The Applications Development Technology Lead Analyst is a senior level position responsible for establishing and implementing new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to lead applications systems analysis and programming activities.
  

  

**Responsibilities:**


* Partner with multiple management teams to ensure appropriate integration of functions to meet goals as well as identify and define necessary system enhancements to deploy new products and process improvements
* Integrate and leverage agentic AI tools (e.g., Devin.AI, Github Copilot) and platforms (e.g., MCP) through advanced prompt engineering to enhance development and operational efficiency.
* **Dashboard Development:** Design, develop, and maintain advanced Tableau dashboards, reports, and visualizations that meet business requirements and provide actionable insights.
* **Data Integration:** Collaborate with data engineers and ETL developers to ensure data availability, accuracy, and optimal performance for Tableau reporting.
* **Requirement Gathering:** Work directly with business users and stakeholders to understand their data needs, gather requirements, and translate them into technical specifications and visualization designs.
* **Performance Optimization:** Optimize Tableau dashboards for performance, scalability, and user experience, implementing best practices for data extraction, transformation, and loading.
* **Data Modeling:** Assist in data modeling efforts to support analytical reporting, ensuring data structures are efficient and aligned with reporting needs.
* **Quality Assurance:** Conduct thorough testing and validation of dashboards to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and adherence to business rules.
* **Governance and Standards:** Establish and enforce Tableau development standards, governance policies, and security protocols.
* **Troubleshooting:** Diagnose and resolve technical issues related to Tableau reports, data sources, and performance.
* Resolve variety of high impact problems/projects through in\-depth evaluation of complex business processes, system processes, and industry standards
* Provide expertise in area and advanced knowledge of applications programming and ensure application design adheres to the overall architecture blueprint
* Utilize advanced knowledge of system flow and develop standards for coding, testing, debugging, and implementation
* Develop comprehensive knowledge of how areas of business, such as architecture and infrastructure, integrate to accomplish business goals
* Provide in\-depth analysis with interpretive thinking to define issues and develop innovative solutions

  

**Recommended Qualifications:**


* 11 \-17 Years of relevant experience in Apps Development or systems analysis role
* Extensive experience system analysis and in programming of software applications
* Experience in managing and implementing successful projects
* Subject Matter Expert (SME) in at least one area of Applications Development
* Ability to adjust priorities quickly as circumstances dictate
* Demonstrated leadership and project management skills
* Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication

  

**Education:**


* Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
* Master’s degree preferred
* **Mentorship and Leadership:** Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior developers, promoting best practices and fostering a collaborative environment. Serve as advisor or coach to mid\-level developers and analysts, allocating work as necessary
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
* **Documentation:** Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for dashboards, data sources, and development processes.
